newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Companion Marble in HK$50 mln notes issue.
newsitem.headline: Companion Marble in HK$50 mln notes issue.

text.p: Companion Marble (Holdings) Ltd said it will issue HK$50 million in unsecured convertible loan notes to third party investors, raising proceeds for working capital and for expansion of its China processing facilities.
The marble and granite products distributor said the notes were to be issued to five investment funds managed by HSBC Private Equity Management Ltd.

Each note entitles holders to the right to convert into the company's shares at an initial conversion price of HK$1.26 per share. The notes will bear an interest rate of six percent per annnum payable quarterly and redeemable on the third anniversary of the date of the notes issue,, it said.
A total 39.68 million new shares, representing 8.12 percent of the company's enlaregd share capital, will be issued upon full conversion of the notes, the company said.
Trading in the company's shares will resume on Tuesday after a one-day suspension on Monday. The shares ended at HK$1.09 each on Friday.
Companion Marble, a spinoff of construction materials concern Companion Building Material (Holdings) Ltd, was listed on the Stock Exchange on April 25, 1996.
